action.objective: Commit the verified bishop move Bxf6, winning a pawn and centralizing, having passed exact depth-4 verification with no forced refutation.
action.rationale: e5f6 is the only commit_ready_move. Verification at completed depth 4 gave an exact score of -66 with safety.complete (no mate in one) and tactical_refutation not_found. Bxf6 captures the f6 pawn, activates the bishop with wide scope (d4,d8,e5,e7,g5,g7,h4,h8), and the PV line d3e4 e1d1 e6e5 f6h4 shows sensible play. Black's captures Qxe4/Qxb3 are answered by defensive resource e1d1. Broad search leader was also e5f6, matching the verification, so evidence is consistent. No risk acceptance is needed.
